commons.description: Brasilia, 02/12/2013 - Brazilian Minister of Culture, Gilberto Gil, delivering to Jawapuku and Kumaré (on behalf of Wajapi people) the Unesco Certificate of Protection to the Oral and Graphic Expressions of the Wajapi as Intangible Heritage of Humanity
commons.editorial_reason: The caption links the people to the Wajapi heritage certificate, but the image shows a modern award presentation with ordinary clothing and no visible traditional cultural dress, craft, performance, or objects.
